visual_system_candidates.name: Thought Bubble Versus Real Face
visual_system_candidates.case_for: The whole story lives in the gap between what she thinks and how she reacts.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Thought bubbles can become too text-heavy.
visual_system_candidates.repair: Use only two thought bubbles before the shout and one tiny old thought bubble after.

visual_system_candidates.name: Doorway Blast Cut
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Gives slide 4 and 5 real story drama: the room changes, then the shout lands.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Could over-stage him as a scared husband.
visual_system_candidates.repair: Keep him normal, surprised, and human.

visual_system_candidates.name: Rage Cleaning Tempo
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Makes the chores reveal emotion without lines.
visual_system_candidates.repair: Use only as early texture, not the whole visual system.

rejected_visual_patterns: best husband returns to repair everything
same sink shot repeated six times
winner: Thought Bubble Versus Real Face merged with Doorway Blast Cut
final_visual_plan: Scene 1: wide kitchen after fight, sharp chores
Scene 3: almost-soft face, folded cloth, second thought bubble
Scene 4: doorway arrival and sound/freeze cue
Scene 6: aftermath freeze with old thought bubble contradiction
